import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from pathway_v43.storage.artifact_store import ArtifactStore
from pathway_v43.pollutant.store import PollutantPathwayStore
from pathway_v43.pollutant.search import SearchLedger
from pathway_v43.pollutant.endpoint import read_run_endpoint
from pathway_v43.pollutant.native_result import build_native_result
from pathway_v43.pollutant.native_export import export_native_result
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);run=sys.argv[2]
ledger=SearchLedger(PollutantPathwayStore(root/run/'pollutant.sqlite'),ArtifactStore(root,run),run)
native=build_native_result(ledger,endpoint_record=read_run_endpoint(ledger,run))
print(json.dumps(export_native_result(ledger,native,root/run),sort_keys=True))
